info.title: Plata Frontend API
info.description:
# Plata Frontend API (E2E dashboard)

Merchant **dashboard** JWT APIs for the Plata FI console — auth/RBAC, apps, products, loan workflow, treasury, KYC, payments, keys, and notifications.

**Production gateway:** `https://account-ms-plata.fly.dev`

| Surface | URL |
|---------|-----|
| This guide (Swagger UI) | `/frontendplata` |
| Integrator API keys guide | `/docs` |
| Multi-service raw OpenAPI hub | `/api-docs` |

---

## Gateway vs separate hosts (payment, billing & compliance)

**payment-ms**, **billing-ms**, and **compliance-ms** are separate Fly services. The console must still call them **through this gateway** (same origin as login JWT), not their public hosts:

| Concern | Separate host (do **not** call from FE) | Use on this gateway |
|---------|------------------------------------------|---------------------|
| Payments | `https://payment-ms.fly.dev` | `/api/v1/payments/*` (process, card, bank-transfer, verify) |
| Billing | billing-ms Fly app | `/api/v1/billing/invoices`, `/one-time-billings`, `/transactions` |
| Compliance / KYC | compliance-ms Fly app | `/api/v1/kyc/*`, `/api/v1/compliance/*` (see **KYC — Business** + **Compliance**) |

account-ms-plata proxies those prefixes. Full upstream OpenAPI (e.g. payment records/ledger) remains in `/api-docs` → **Payment** / **Compliance** when a field is missing here.

**Documented but not live yet (OpenAPI lists them; upstream returns 404):**

| Path | Status |
|------|--------|
| `GET /apps/{id}/configuration*`, app submit/approve/reject, `/pwa-templates*` | Not on create-app-ms-plata (color/font catalogs **are** live) |
| `POST …/pending-approved-mortgage/contract/approve` | Not implemented on product-ms-plata |
| `/api/v1/applications/*` (storefront wizard) | Spring storefront gateway only — not proxied on account-ms-plata |
| `/api/v1/payment-methods*` | Not implemented on payment-ms-plata |

**Live additions (this revision):** `PUT /products/toggle/{appId}/{productId}`, `GET /pwa/color-options`, `GET /pwa/font-options`, `DELETE /apps/{id}/product-key`.

**Wallet ledger for the dashboard:** use `GET /api/v1/frontend-plata/treasury/wallets/{walletType}/transactions?appId=` (`treasury` / `billing` / `repayment`). The `/api/v1/wallets/{type}/{merchantId}/transactions` paths exist for integrator/API-key callers.

---

## Authentication

1. `POST /api/v1/auth/login` → `accessToken`
2. All dashboard calls: `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>`

Do **not** send `PLATA_PUBLIC_KEY` / `PLATA_SECRET_KEY` on these routes. Keys are for merchant backends via `/docs`.

---

## E2E console flow

| Step | What | Start here |
|------|------|------------|
| 1 | Login + RBAC bootstrap | `POST /auth/login` → `GET /auth/me` |
| 2 | Create / select app | `GET|POST /apps` (provisions Billing / Treasury / Repayment) |
| 3 | Business KYC | `/kyc/business/*` (first submit may charge Billing) |
| 4 | Build products | `/products` wizard + `PUT /products/{id}` tabs |
| 5 | Loan/mortgage queue | `GET …/applications/…/loan-workflow` → `PATCH` status |
| 6 | Treasury console | `/frontend-plata/treasury/*` (fund, approve/reject payouts) |
| 7 | Repayment bank payout | `POST /wallets/repayment/payout` |
| 8 | Team + API keys | `/team/*`, `/roles/*`, `/keys` |
| 9 | Inbox | `GET /notifications/user/{userId}` |

---

## RBAC

| Need | Endpoint |
|------|----------|
| Login session | `POST /api/v1/auth/login` → `permissions[]`, `isOwner`, `roleName` |
| Reload | `GET /api/v1/auth/me` |
| Permission catalog (Create Role UI) | `GET /api/v1/roles/permissions` → `catalog` |

Owner: `isOwner === true`. Staff: gate UI with `permissions.includes(…)`. See `plata/client-auth-ms/docs/frontend-staff-roles.md`.

Roles/team are **merchant-scoped** (not `appId`). Treasury/products lists usually need `appId`.

---

## Money model

| Wallet | Role |
|--------|------|
| **Treasury** | Lend out / approve maturity payouts |
| **Repayment** | Collect deposits, **loan repayments**, **mortgage equity**; bank payout |
| **Billing** | Platform fees (monthly, business KYC) |

**App create** provisions exactly three merchant wallets: `TREASURY` + `BILLING` + `REPAYMENT` (not Operation / KYC).

**Loan / mortgage collect:** money leaves the customer **product wallet** (PRIMARY fallback) and credits the Originating FI app **Repayment** wallet via wallet-ms `POST /internal/api/v1/wallets/repayment/collect` (or `/loan-repayment/collection`) with `debitUserWallet: true` and categories such as `LOAN_REPAYMENT` / `MORTGAGE_EQUITY`.

Merchant wallet payloads include `companyName` from compliance KYC (not `appName`).

Amounts are **NGN naira** (major units) unless noted.

---

## Response shapes (critical)

| Endpoint | Shape |
|----------|--------|
| `GET /products?appId=` | `data.items` + `data.pagination` |
| `GET /apps` | `data` = array, `pagination` sibling |
| `GET /apps/{id}/transactions` | `data` = array, `pagination` sibling |
| Loan-workflow lists | `data` = array, `meta: { total, limit, skip }` |
| Treasury queues / wallet txns | `data.items` + `data.pagination` |
| Notifications inbox | `limit` + `offset` |
| Product overview by type | `data.savingsAccounts` / `investmentAccounts` / `commodityAccounts` (or loan/mortgage) + `portfolioAccountsMeta`; filter `?portfolioStatus=active\|inactive\|all` |

---

## Savings / investment / commodity account tables

`GET /api/v1/products/app/{appId}/product-overview/by-type/SAVINGS` (same for `INVESTMENT`, `COMMODITY`):

| Goal | Query |
|------|--------|
| Open / approved holdings | `portfolioStatus=active` |
| Withdrawn / closed | `portfolioStatus=inactive` |
| Everything | omit or `portfolioStatus=all` |

Row shapes: `SavingsPortfolioAccountRow`, `InvestmentPortfolioAccountRow`, `CommodityPortfolioAccountRow` in Schemas. Pending maturity cash-outs to approve are under Treasury withdrawals/settlements, not this filter alone.

---

## Loan workflow body

`PATCH …/loan-workflow` uses `loanWorkflowStatus`: `requested` | `under_review` | `approved` | `declined` | `blacklisted` (not `action`). Equity unpaid → **409**. Approve auto-disburses from Treasury when gates pass.

---

## Treasury console

1. Overview — balances + pending total  
2. Funding instructions — NUBAN for Treasury/Billing  
3. Withdrawals — Approve Selected / Reject  
4. Settlements — Matured investments / commodities / savings; manual or automatic mode  
5. **History** — after decide: `GET …/treasury/withdrawals/history` and `GET …/treasury/settlements/{type}/history` (`status=approved|rejected|all`)

Pending savings withdrawals notify the merchant owner (`treasury-withdrawal-pending-merchant`) when enqueued — not a separate HTTP route.

ProductStructure.description: Structure tab. Deep-merged on PUT: send only the keys you are changing. Dropdown values must match the options endpoints named on each field. Keys not listed here are stripped and will not be stored.

interestRate.description: Annual interest percent. Number or numeric string.

interestMethod.description: LOAN / MORTGAGE: GET /options/interest-method. SAVINGS: GET /options/savings-interest-method. Typical values: `fixed_amount`, `reducing_balance`.

allowMoratorium.description: MORTGAGE / LOAN. When false, moratorium is off.

moratorium.description: Moratorium length. Often a number of months, or an object from GET /options/moratorium.

acceptableNPA.description: GET /options/acceptable-npa. Stored as a string day count: `30`, `60`, `90`, `120`, `180`.

repaymentStructure.description: MORTGAGE. GET /options/repayment-structure. This is separate from `repaymentSchedule`. Example from the configure form: `Annuity`.

mortgageAmount.description: MORTGAGE facility amount in naira. Number or numeric string.

equityContribution.description: MORTGAGE equity inside structure. When `equityRequirement` is `percentage_based`, send the percent (for example 20). Also accepted as a top-level product field.

equityFixedAmount.description: MORTGAGE equity in naira when `equityRequirement` is `fixed_amount`. Send 0 when unused.

loanAmount.description: LOAN principal range in naira. This is the loan facility, not `mortgageAmount`.

savingsTermsAndCondition.description: SAVINGS terms shown on the structure tab.

returnsOnInvestment.description: INVESTMENT expected return percent. Number or numeric string.

investmentType.description: INVESTMENT. `lump_sum` or `unit_based`. `unitAmount` is rejected when this is `lump_sum`.

investmentTermsAndCondition.description: INVESTMENT terms shown on the structure tab.

enableUnitInvestmentPurchase.description: INVESTMENT. When true, buyers purchase units.

unitAmount.description: INVESTMENT unit purchase `{ amount, minQuantity }` when `investmentType` is `unit_based`. COMMODITY live per-unit price as a number or numeric string.

maxAmount.description: COMMODITY maximum order amount in naira.

yieldMethod.description: COMMODITY yield method key used by the configure form.

offerYield.description: COMMODITY offered yield percent. Number or numeric string.

commodityTermsAndCondition.description: COMMODITY terms shown on the structure tab.

requirementType.description: Row label, for example Account Statement.

requireApplicantSignature.description: When true, external submit requires an applicant signature upload (non-draft).

commodityPrices.description: COMMODITY price history. Sending this array replaces the whole list. Live purchase price is `structure.unitAmount`.

unitOfMeasure.description: COMMODITY legacy unit label, for example `bag`.

offeringMerchantShareBps.description: Share for the offering / distributing merchant, in basis points.

yield.description: SAVINGS / INVESTMENT / COMMODITY yield or spread split (use instead of interest when applicable).

put.description:
Save configuration for an existing LOAN, MORTGAGE, SAVINGS, INVESTMENT, or COMMODITY product.

**Call:** `PUT /api/v1/products/{id}` with the merchant Bearer token. Send only the tabs that changed. `{id}` is the product id from create or from the product list. Pick an example in this operation for the product type you are editing.

**What gets stored**
- `structure`, `about`, `requirements`, and `feesAndCharges` are deep-merged. A key you leave out of those objects stays as it was. A key you send overwrites that key.
- Arrays replace the whole list when you send them: `about.loanTypes`, `about.mortgageTypes`, `about.savingsTypes`, `about.investmentTypes`, `about.commodityTypes`, `feesAndCharges.fees`, `feesAndCharges.forcefulWithdrawalPenalties`, `requirements.otherRequirements`, `properties`, `inspectionDates`, `commodityPrices`.
- An empty array clears that list.
- A field that is not on `UpdateProductRequest` / `ProductStructure` is dropped. The HTTP response can still be 200, and a later GET will not show that field.
- Only send tabs the product type stores. `inspectionDates` and `properties` persist on MORTGAGE. `requirements` persist on LOAN and MORTGAGE. `commodityPrices`, `price`, `minimumQuantity`, and `unitOfMeasure` persist on COMMODITY.

**Loan**
| Form | JSON |
| --- | --- |
| Interest rate / method | `structure.interestRate`, `structure.interestMethod` (GET `/options/interest-method`) |
| Moratorium | `structure.allowMoratorium`, `structure.moratoriumType`, `structure.moratorium` |
| Repayment workflow / amortization / schedule / frequency | `structure.repaymentWorkflow`, `structure.amortizationSchedule`, `structure.repaymentSchedule`, `structure.repaymentFrequency` |
| Acceptable NPA | `structure.acceptableNPA` (string, e.g. `"90"`) |
| Equity | `structure.equityRequirement` plus `structure.equityContribution` or `structure.equityFixedAmount` |
| Principal range (naira) | `structure.loanAmount.min` / `structure.loanAmount.max` |
| Tenure / loan types | `about.tenure`, `about.loanTypes` |
| Security and documents | `requirements.security`, `requirements.documentsToDownload`, `requirements.otherRequirements` |
| Fees | `feesAndCharges.fees`, `deductAllChargesOnLoan`, `customerPaysChargesBeforeDisbursement`, `lateRepayment` |
| Applicant signature | `requireApplicantSignature` |

**Mortgage**
| Form | JSON |
| --- | --- |
| Interest, moratorium, workflow, amortization, frequency, NPA | same `structure` keys as loan |
| Repayment structure | `structure.repaymentStructure` (GET `/options/repayment-structure`, e.g. `Annuity`) |
| Mortgage amount (naira) | `structure.mortgageAmount` |
| Equity percent / fixed amount | `structure.equityContribution`, `structure.equityFixedAmount` |
| Tenure / mortgage types / preview | `about.tenure`, `about.mortgageTypes`, `about.previewAssetUrl` |
| Property value (naira) | top-level `propertyValue` |
| Inspection date, label, location, notes | `inspectionDates[]` (`scheduledFor` is required ISO-8601). Not inside `structure`. |
| Properties tab | `properties[]` |

**Savings**
| Form | JSON |
| --- | --- |
| Interest rate | `structure.interestRate` |
| Interest method | `structure.interestMethod` (GET `/options/savings-interest-method`) |
| Savings type | `structure.savingsType` (`fixed_savings` \| `flexible_savings`) |
| Withdrawal flexibility | `structure.withdrawalFlexibility` |
| Amount range (naira) | `structure.savingsAmount.min` / `max` |
| Terms | `structure.savingsTermsAndCondition` |
| Duration / savings types | `about.duration`, `about.savingsTypes` |
| Early withdrawal penalty | `feesAndCharges.chargeForForcefulWithdrawal`, `feesAndCharges.forcefulWithdrawalPenalties` |

**Investment**
| Form | JSON |
| --- | --- |
| Expected return | `structure.returnsOnInvestment` |
| Interest method | `structure.interestMethod` |
| Investment type | `structure.investmentType` (`lump_sum` \| `unit_based`). Do not send `unitAmount` when type is `lump_sum`. |
| Unit price | `structure.unitAmount` as `{ amount, minQuantity }` when `unit_based` |
| Enable unit purchase | `structure.enableUnitInvestmentPurchase` |
| Amount range | `structure.investmentAmount.min` / `max` |
| Withdrawal flexibility / moratorium days | `structure.withdrawalFlexibility`, `structure.moratorium` |
| Terms | `structure.investmentTermsAndCondition` |
| Duration / investment types | `about.duration`, `about.investmentTypes` |
| Fees and early withdrawal | `feesAndCharges.fees`, `chargeForForcefulWithdrawal`, `forcefulWithdrawalPenalties` |

**Commodity**
| Form | JSON |
| --- | --- |
| Live unit price | `structure.unitAmount` (number) |
| Minimum units / max order (naira) | `structure.minQuantityPurchase`, `structure.maxAmount` |
| Yield | `structure.yieldMethod`, `structure.offerYieldEnabled`, `structure.offerYield` |
| Withdrawal flexibility / terms | `structure.withdrawalFlexibility`, `structure.commodityTermsAndCondition` |
| Commodity types / preview | `about.commodityTypes`, `about.previewAssetUrl` |
| Price history | `commodityPrices[]` (`price`, `date`, `source`). Replaces the whole list. |
| Legacy unit fields | top-level `price`, `minimumQuantity`, `unitOfMeasure` |

**After save:** `GET /api/v1/products/{id}` returns the stored tabs on `data`. `PUT /api/v1/products/{id}/manage` uses this same body and returns 403 unless `status` is `complete`.

Load dropdowns from `GET /api/v1/products/options/{slug}` before submit.

get.description:
Merchant portfolio drill-down for one discriminator.

**Account tables (filter with `portfolioStatus`):**
| `productType` | Array on `data` | Open / approved | Withdrawn / closed |
|----------------|------------------|-----------------|--------------------|
| `SAVINGS` | `savingsAccounts` | `status: active` | `status: inactive` (`cancelled` / `withdrawn` apps) |
| `INVESTMENT` | `investmentAccounts` | `active` | `inactive` (matured / closed / withdrawn) |
| `COMMODITY` | `commodityAccounts` | `active` | `inactive` |
| `LOAN` / `MORTGAGE` | `loanAccounts` / `mortgageAccounts` | `active` | `inactive` (+ `non_performing`, `bad`) |

Examples:
- Open savings: `?portfolioStatus=active`
- Withdrawn/closed savings: `?portfolioStatus=inactive`
- All rows: omit or `portfolioStatus=all` (default)

Pagination for the account array: `limit` + `skip` → `data.portfolioAccountsMeta` (`total`, `hasMore`).
KPI buckets (counts, pending withdrawals, recent activity) remain on `*Portfolio` objects and are not re-filtered the same way as the account table.

post.description: Frontend order: upload files (`POST /api/v1/kyc/upload`), attach them (`PUT /api/v1/kyc/business/documents`), then submit. Submit needs all required document types attached (see the PUT endpoint); `license` is optional. Shareholders are not required to submit. A shareholder needs a BVN or NIN when it is created (beneficial owners endpoint), so document saves never fail on shareholder rules. First successful submit may charge Billing wallet (one-time business KYC fee). CAC/AML checks use **QoreID** (CAC Premium + AML/PEP) on compliance-ms (`QOREID_*` required). Director ID = QoreID NIN only; digital address = QoreID VeriFind (`verifind_4d` SDK).

get.summary: List the caller's business KYC documents
get.description:
Always the authenticated merchant's own documents. Each item has `_id`, `type`, `fileName`, `fileType`, `fileSize`, `uploadDate`, `status` (`pending|approved|rejected…`), `rejectionReason?`, `fileUrl`, `displayName`. Use `GET /api/v1/kyc/business/document/{documentId}` for one.

**Frontend: call this on page load and fill the upload slots from it.** Map each item's `type` to its slot (for example `director_identification` → Director Identification, `license` → Operating License) and show `fileName` plus `status`. Without this, a reload shows every slot as empty even when the files are saved.

200.description: List the caller's business KYC documents

put.summary: Attach uploaded files as business KYC documents (step 2 of 2)
put.description: **Business document flow:** (1) upload each file with `POST /api/v1/kyc/upload`; (2) send all chosen files here, one entry per document `type`; (3) submit with `POST /api/v1/kyc/business/submit`. **Document types:** required — `certificate_of_incorporation`, `articles_of_association`, `list_of_shareholders`, `proof_of_address`, `bank_statement`, `aml_policies`, `data_privacy_policy`, `director_identification`. Optional — `license` (Operating License, never required). `director_identification` is required (8 required types in total). Send the returned `key` (or `url`) with each `type`. Upserts one document per type, resets it to `pending`, and does **not** change the overall KYC status. The file must have been uploaded by the same user. A document already `approved` cannot be replaced (`409 DOCUMENT_ALREADY_APPROVED`). Errors carry a `code`: `DOCUMENTS_REQUIRED`, `TOO_MANY_DOCUMENTS`, `INVALID_DOCUMENTS` (with `details[{index,field,message}]`), `KYC_PROFILE_NOT_FOUND` (404 — submit business KYC first), `DOCUMENT_ALREADY_APPROVED` (409).
